cases.name: Native Sales creation cannot enable credit, choose a price tier or create a privileged partner classification
Ordinary customer defaults and explicit STORE creation remain available to Sales
Sales cannot change existing credit, pricing tier or classification and rejected updates leave no state or audit changes
Contact edits and unchanged protected fields from a full form round trip remain valid
Merge preview protects ownership on either source or target without changing customers or history
Merge confirmation rechecks newly assigned ownership after preview and rolls back every mutation
Portal orders without a primary owner protect preview and stale confirmation on either side without moving memberships or immutable order snapshots
An ordinary customer pair without protected Sales or Portal records still follows the native audited merge workflow

limitation: Customer canonical merging is intentionally rejected when either side has primary Sales ownership or Portal orders; no implicit ownership/history migration is performed.
